integrity: Fully included self-contained proof and standalone standard-library consistency checker; numerical checks supplement exact algebra.
scientific_limitations: Only periods dividing two are excluded; no global endemic-basin, higher-period, or finite-population persistence theorem. Smooth witness changes incidence law. Historical-priority comparisons are bounded and cannot certify uniqueness.
title: No prime-two orbits and unconditional endemic Schur stability in one-stage exact-round contagion
